question: Who has been awarded Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in the year 2016 for the contribution to Chhau?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Gopal Prasad Dubey.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Gopal Prasad Dubey:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian classical dancer, known for his expertise in the Indian classical dance form of Chhau.**
 
• He is considered by many as the leading exponent of the Seraikella variant of the art form.
 
• Dubey has performed and taught Chhau dance all over the world, and has received numerous awards and honors for his contributions to the art form.
 
• In 2012, he was awarded the Padma Shri, the fourth highest civilian award in India.
 
• **He was also awarded Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in the year 2016 for the contribution to Chhau.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** Vidushi K.S. Jayalakshmi:-**

 
 
• **She is a Sanskrit scholar, journalist, and editor. **
 
• She is the current editor of Sudharma, the world's only Sanskrit daily newspaper, which is published in Mysore, India.
 
 
 
• **Sheik Mahaboob Subhani:-**
 
 
• **He was a Carnatic musician who was born in Andhra Pradesh in 1932. **
 
• He was a master of the nagaswaram, a double-reeded wind instrument.
 
• He began his performing career at the age of seven, but due to family circumstances he had to work as a clerk in a tobacco company. 
 
 
 
• **Suchitra Ella:-**
 
 
• **She is the co-founder and Joint Managing Director of Bharat Biotech, a biotechnology company based in Hyderabad, India. **
 
• She is a leading figure in the Indian biotechnology industry and has played a key role in the development of several important vaccines, including the Covaxin vaccine against COVID-19.
